message:
Yes—Plan B gives you later morning starts. Its studio meets Tue/Thu 10:00–11:40 a.m., replacing Plan A’s Mon/Wed 8:00–9:15 a.m. studio. Your Monday 10:00 a.m. class remains in both.

The tradeoff: B spreads classes across four days instead of three and leaves just 20 minutes before your Tue/Thu noon work shifts. Both include Thursday lab 5:30–6:20 p.m., 30 minutes after work.

Both are feasible at 13 credits, satisfy the required course, lab, and prerequisites, and avoid class/work conflicts. B is better if later mornings matter most; A keeps Tuesday free of classes.

Saved Plan A and your current enrollment remain unchanged.
